def transform(grid):
 left=[row[:4] for row in grid]; right=[row[5:9] for row in grid]
 if any(a and b for x,y in zip(left,right) for a,b in zip(x,y)):
  return left
 return [[b if b else a for a,b in zip(x,y)] for x,y in zip(left,right)]
